verdict: Converaid toolbar and panel windows must stay out of the Windows taskbar. Keep overlay and tray access available, including after visibility or privacy-state changes. This changes ordinary taskbar presence and does not promise invisibility to screen-sharing tools.
why: The user explicitly reversed the earlier visible-taskbar requirement and wants the overlay as the normal access point.

decided.quote: English translation: It must not appear down in the Windows bar. It should only be in the overlay bar.
